title: The good-looking gourd badi
literal_meaning: Beautiful to look at—a gourd badi.
meaning_odia: କଖାରୁ ବଡ଼ିର ଦେଖିବା ସୁନ୍ଦର ବୋଲି ଏହି ସଂକ୍ଷିପ୍ତ ପଦ କହୁଛି। ବାହାର ଦେଖାର ପ୍ରଶଂସାକୁ ଧରି ଏହାକୁ ଆମେ ଏଠାରେ ଟିପ୍ପଣୀ ଭାବେ ପଢ଼ୁଛୁ: ଦେଖିବାକୁ ଭଲ ଲାଗିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅନ୍ୟ ଗୁଣର ବିଚାର ବାକି ରହେ। ଏହି ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ବଡ଼ିର ସ୍ୱାଦ କିମ୍ବା ଖାଦ୍ୟଗୁଣ ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ରାୟ ନୁହେଁ।
explanation: The phrase offers praise specifically for appearance. Our editorial reading hears a reservation within that limited praise: looking attractive does not settle the question of quality. The food supplies the comparison; the verse does not actually describe its taste.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A proposal arrives in an elegant presentation, but its practical details remain weak. Someone responds with the comparison to a good-looking gourd badi.
cultural_context: Badi names a dried pulse-based food preparation; this one includes gourd. The saying draws its compact image from a recognisable food and places all its expressed praise on how it looks.

witnesses.locator: Page25, sixth item beginning ଦେଖା ସୁନ୍ଦର.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; exact spelling and separate କଖାରୁ ବଡି retained. Literal praise concerns appearance; sceptical appearance-versus-quality application is editorial, without asserting anything about the food’s taste.
